Messages.Author: the.pa...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Ability: Danielle has 1 vote. During your untap phase, if Danielle is
ready and has no blood, move 2 blood from the blood bank to her.

What if Danielle has 1 blood during untap and I move it to my pool
with Vessel, will her ability kick in and grant her 2 blood? My guess
is yes.

But what if Danielle has two more vessels? That means I can move in
those two blood I just gained. Will her ability kick in again and
again (depending on how many vessels I have)?

Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:
On Oct 25, 2:56 pm, the.papasm...@gmail.com wrote:
> Ability: Danielle has 1 vote. During your untap phase, if Danielle is
> ready and has no blood, move 2 blood from the blood bank to her.
>
> What if Danielle has 1 blood during untap and I move it to my pool
> with Vessel, will her ability kick in and grant her 2 blood? My guess
> is yes.

Yes, why not? You can order things to do in your untap phase as you
like.

> But what if Danielle has two more vessels? That means I can move in
> those two blood I just gained. Will her ability kick in again and
> again (depending on how many vessels I have)?

No. The "During phase X, do Y" template is used to indicate that
during phase X you can do Y only *once*. See for instance this
post by LSJ:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/3c6009b98bbfd566

Ciao,
Emiliano

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <1193321028....@y27g2000pre.googlegroups.com>,

quetzalcoatl <da...@vega.id.au> writes:
>I may be wrong here, but vampire card text may only be enacted once
>for special abilities I believe.

That depends entirely on the wording of the ability.

- If it's phrased "During X, do Y", then it's only once during X. e.g.
"During an action, Womble Vampire can burn a blood to get +1
intercept", once during an action.
- If it actually says "once" or whatever then yeah, once.

But other things, not so much.

- Julio Martinez can burn as much blood as he has to get intercept.
